findings.title: 后台子代理转录把撤销当作封口，保留已经作废的部分回复
findings.aliasDisposition: Same item promoted once; not counted again as candidate or related
findings.validation: Static production-source proof and independent review; no runtime/UI/model/fixture/test execution
findings.condition: An active background subagent emits partial text, then an eligible recoverable non-abort streaming failure enters ordinary non-streaming fallback while its TUI detail remains viewed/available.
findings.expected: Revoke the failed attempt display entries before showing replacement content.
findings.actual: tombstone shares the turn_complete branch, seals the old assistant row and clears the local pointer without deleting its text. Replacement deltas create a separate row; the registry transcript still includes revoked partial content.
findings.producer: TurnLoop2103–2115 and2197–2228 emits revocation then a correlated replacement start/text delta. Default child callbacks deliver tombstone through the background detailSink.
findings.consumer: TUI App2145–2169 reads registry transcript and passes entries to VirtualMessageList; agent-scoped tombstones are skipped by main-feed reduction, not a cleanup of this transcript.
findings.impact: Incorrect stale/redundant partial text in active background-agent detail during fallback or subsequent work. No claim of observed UI frames, persistent/raw session corruption or continued visibility after successful completion.
findings.deduplication: Old July09F01 explicitly covers Desktop correlation-ID/final-upsert mismatch; current producer already has stable IDs and replacement deltas. R20 StreamAttempt covers main attempt filtering and preserves child rows. This separate translator consumer does not apply revocation; same family acknowledged without reissuing old Desktop bug.
findings.fixDirection: Track current request/message correlation and remove its temporary transcript entries on a matching tombstone, preserving prior completed turns and normal turn_complete sealing.
